item.title: AltLLM Joins BNB Chain’s Agent Survival Pack Campaign
item.dc:creator: AltLayer
item.content:encoded:
AltLLM Joins BNB Chain’s Agent Survival Pack Campaign

Use BNB25 discount code to get 25% off AltLLM credits when paying with $BNB on BNB Chain

AltLLM is joining BNB Chain’s Agent Survival Pack, a new initiative bringing together AI infrastructure projects that help autonomous agents access services with payments settled on BNB Chain.

The campaign runs from May 25 to June 8, giving users a chance to try AltLLM with a limited-time discount.

During the campaign, users can apply the discount code BNB25 to get 25% off AltLLM credits when paying with $BNB on BNB Chain. The discount is capped at $5.

Start here: altllm.ai

Crypto-Native AI on BNB Chain

Most crypto users today still move between multiple tools to understand what is happening on-chain.

They check dashboards, scan protocol docs, compare DeFi opportunities, follow ecosystem updates, and then decide what to do next. For autonomous agents, the problem is even bigger. Agents need more than information. They need access to live context, payments, wallets, and execution environments.

AltLLM is built to bring these pieces together.

On BNB Chain, AltLLM combines live ecosystem intelligence with autonomous agent deployment, helping users move from on-chain insight to action more easily.

AltLLM brings together two core products:

AltLLM Chat

AltLLM Chat helps users query live BNB Chain ecosystem data through natural language.

Instead of checking multiple dashboards or apps manually, users can ask questions and get structured context across apps, DeFi, and on-chain activity.

Users can explore things like:

  • TVL rankings
  • DeFi opportunities
  • ecosystem activity
  • protocol data
  • on-chain trends
  • app-level insights

AltClaw

AltClaw helps users move from insight to action by deploying autonomous agents on managed virtual machines.

Users can deploy agents such as OpenClaw, PicoClaw, Hermes, and Ottie. Each agent can have its own wallet and execute BNB Chain tasks through natural language.

This makes it easier to experiment with agents that can run 24/7, use wallets, and interact with on-chain applications.

Why Agent-Payable Infrastructure Matters

Autonomous agents are becoming more capable, but they need infrastructure that matches how they operate.

They need to access services.
They need to pay for resources.
They need wallets.
They need reliable execution environments.

BNB Chain’s Agent Survival Pack highlights this shift toward agent-payable infrastructure, where agents can access and pay for services directly on-chain.

AltLLM is excited to be part of this stack, helping make agent-powered workflows easier to try on BNB Chain.

Campaign Details

The BNB Chain Agent Survival Pack campaign runs from May 25 to June 8, 2026.

During the campaign, users can receive 25% discount off AltLLM credits when paying with $BNB on BNB Chain.

Campaign: BNB Chain Agent Survival Pack
Dates: May 25 — June 8, 2026
Discount code: BNB25
Offer: 25% off AltLLM credits
Payment method: $BNB on BNB Chain
Discount cap: $5
Website: altllm.ai

How to Use the BNB25 Discount Code on AltLLM.ai

Follow the steps below to apply the discount code and top up your AltLLM credits with $BNB.

Tutorial: How to Use the BNB25 Discount Code on altllm.ai

Step 1: Visit AltLLM.ai and click API & Portal. Then sign in or create an account using your wallet, Google, Apple, or email.

Step 2: You’ll be redirected to the Portal page, where you can manage your billing, API key usage, and account settings.

Step 3: Click the Add Credits button. This will redirect you to the Billing and Credits page

Step 4: Click + Add Credits, choose the amount you want to top up, and apply the discount code BNB25 to get 25% off (capped at $5).

Please note: the discount only applies when paying with $BNB on BNB Chain.

Step 5: Once everything is set, click Pay with Crypto. You’ll be redirected to the payment page, where you need to send the specified amount of $BNB to the provided address.

Please make sure you send the exact amount on BNB Chain, then wait for the payment to be processed and confirmed.

Step 6: Once the payment is confirmed, you’ll be redirected back to the Billing and Credits page. Your updated credit balance will appear in your account, and you’re ready to start using AltLLM!

Prefer watching the steps? We’ve also prepared a short video tutorial to walk you through the process: https://youtu.be/mcbCHQJyzgU

How to Use the BNB25 Discount Code via AltLLM skill

Step 1: Install the AltLLM Skill from https://github.com/alt-research/altllm-skills

Step 2: Authenticate your wallet securely using either signature-based login or a locally provided private key. AltLLM supports reading private keys from environment variables or files instead of passing them directly through the command line.

Step 3: Purchase AltLLM credits directly from the CLI using the topup-crypto command. Apply the BNB25 discount code and complete the payment using BNB on BNB Chain to enjoy 25% off your purchase (capped at $5 discount).

Step 4: Once the payment link is created, the payment details and checkout information will be displayed for you to complete the transaction using your preferred wallet.

Step 5: You can either open the generated payment link to complete the transaction manually or retrieve the payment address and transaction details for your agent or automation workflow to process the payment programmatically.

Step 6: Check the payment status to verify whether the transaction has been successfully completed and the AltLLM credits have been credited to your account.

Start Building with AltLLM

Whether you want to query live BNB Chain data, explore DeFi opportunities, or deploy autonomous agents with wallets and 24/7 runtime, AltLLM gives you a simple way to start.

Try AltLLM during the Agent Survival Pack campaign and use BNB25 when paying with $BNB for AltLLM credits.

Start here: altllm.ai

item.title: AltLayer Achieves ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Certification
item.dc:creator: AltLayer
item.content:encoded:
AltLayer has officially achieved the ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certification, marking a significant milestone in our journey to provide the world’s most secure blockchain infrastructure. As the demand for scalable blockchain solutions grows, the need for Rollup-as-a-Service (RaaS) security has never been more critical. This certification serves as a third-party validation that AltLayer’s Information Security Management System (ISMS) and supporting operational controls meet international information security standards. For our partners and the broader Web3 ecosystem, this ensures that AltLayer is not just a leader in performance, but a pioneer in professional-grade reliability.

The transition from experimental “alpha” stages of blockchain development to mass-market adoption requires a shift in how we approach risk. By securing this certification, AltLayer positions itself as a secure ISO 27001 Blockchain Provider, bridging the gap between the decentralized world and the rigorous requirements of global finance and enterprise operations.

What Is ISO/IEC 27001:2022 and Why Does It Matter for Rollups?

The ISO/IEC 27001:2022 standard is the international benchmark for managing information security. Certification to this standard assesses an organization’s Information Security Management System (ISMS), providing independent assurance of how people, processes, and technology are governed to protect information assets.

As rollups increasingly support high-value and high-throughput environments, operational security and governance become critical. ISO/IEC 27001 provides a structured, risk-based framework for managing these risks at the organizational and process level.

Our RaaS infrastructure, operated under an ISO/IEC 27001:2022-certified Information Security Management System (ISMS), is designed to manage these exact risks. By adhering to this standard, AltLayer has implemented rigorous controls to ensure the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information assets and prevent:

  • Unauthorized Access: Implementing access control and security measures to manage the risk of unauthorized access to systems within scope.
  • System Downtime: Establishing and maintaining documented, tested, and reviewed availability and disaster recovery arrangements to support service continuity.
  • Data Breaches: Applying controls to manage risks to the confidentiality, integrity, and availability (CIA) of information assets belonging to AltLayer, its partners, and end-users, within the ISMS scope.

For a rollup to be truly resilient, it needs more than just cryptographic proofs; it needs an institutional-grade operational backbone. An ISO/IEC 27001:2022-certified Information Security Management System (ISMS) provides a structured framework for managing security as a continual improvement cycle, with defined processes for monitoring, reviewing, and enhancing controls in response to an evolving threat landscape.

What ISO 27001 Certified RaaS Means for Existing and New AltLayer Partners

This certification is a transformative development for our entire ecosystem. Whether you are an existing developer or a prospective enterprise partner, the transition from standard Rollups to secure Rollups aligns blockchain operations with global enterprise security standards.

Existing Customers

For our current partners, this achievement offers an immediate upgrade to your own security posture. Your rollups are supported by infrastructure managed in accordance with AltLayer’s ISO/IEC 27001:2022-certified ISMS. This provides you with enhanced trust to share with your community and investors. Furthermore, as your projects grow and seek their own regulatory approvals or enterprise partnerships, AltLayer’s Compliance Framework provides a strong, audit-ready foundation that can support partners in their own compliance and assurance efforts.

New Customers

For teams looking to launch their own chains, the choice of an infrastructure provider is the most critical decision they will make. Onboarding with AltLayer is now more secure than ever. New customers gain the confidence of working with a RaaS provider designed to meet the operational and security expectations of institutional clients.

Institutional Clients

The primary beneficiaries of this milestone are banks, traditional financial institutions, and large-scale enterprises. For these entities, “trust me” is not a viable strategy; they require audited, verifiable security. AltLayer’s institutional-grade Rollups satisfy the strict procurement and risk management requirements of the Fortune 500. By offering a Secure Rollup as a Service for enterprises, we make it possible for regulated entities to deploy institutional rollup without compromising on their internal compliance mandates. This certification removes a critical barrier for institutions exploring on-chain infrastructure.

Institutional-grade Rollups Demand More Than Performance

Choosing an ISO 27001 Blockchain Provider is a signal that an organization values long-term stability over short-term hype. This certification is a core component of a broader Compliance Framework that takes into account the legal and operational realities of the modern world. For banks, funds, credit managers, and other regulated institutions, the ability to demonstrate that their blockchain infrastructure is operated by a provider with an ISO/IEC 27001:2022-certified Information Security Management System (ISMS) is often a critical factor in regulatory and internal risk assessments.

Institutional-grade Rollups must be built to withstand not just hackers, but also the scrutiny of auditors. This involves:

  1. Risk Assessment: Systematically identifying and assessing risks to information assets to support timely and appropriate risk treatment.
  2. Asset Management: Maintaining a strict registry of critical infrastructure, such as sequencing hardware and cloud environments, enforcing the principle of least privilege to ensure audited personnel possess only the minimum permissions necessary to manage the rollup. Maintaining defined inventories, ownership, and access controls for critical infrastructure, such as sequencing components and cloud environments, and enforcing the principle of least privilege so that personnel are granted only the access required for their roles.
  3. Physical and Environmental Security: Applying appropriate physical and environmental security controls to cloud environments used in the delivery and operation of rollups, in line with the ISMS scope.

For regulated Web3 entrants, such as stablecoin issuers or tokenized real-world asset (RWA) platforms, AltLayer provides the best RaaS for institutional clients. We provide the technical agility of a cutting-edge L2 solution combined with the professional rigor of a global financial service provider. We are not just building institutional layer 2 solutions; we are building the trust layer for the future of finance.

The New Gold Standard for Rollups

AltLayer’s achievement of the ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certification marks a turning point in the RaaS industry. We have moved beyond the “move fast and break things” era into a period of mature, reliable, and secure Rollups. This positions AltLayer firmly among the top RaaS providers for institutional clients, offering a level of transparency and accountability that is rare in the decentralized space.

As we continue to innovate with restaked rollups, fast finality layers, and decentralized sequencing, our commitment to security remains unwavering. We understand that for our partners to build the future, they need a foundation they can rely on, one that has been tested against the highest international standards.

By integrating the principles of confidentiality, integrity, and availability across our engineering practices and operational processes, AltLayer is ensuring that the next generation of the internet is not only faster but safer for everyone.

Security is not a feature, but the foundation of AltLayer’s rollups.

item.title: Reflections on 2025 and the Road Ahead for AltLayer
item.dc:creator: AltLayer
item.content:encoded:
2025 was a defining year for AltLayer.

What began as a focus on strengthening rollup infrastructure evolved into a year of deep technical progress, ecosystem expansion, and strategic experimentation across AI, fast finality, restaking, and modular blockchain design. Throughout the year, our goal remained consistent: to make scalable, secure, and customizable blockchain infrastructure that is easier to deploy and operate. These efforts extended across rollups, fast-finality layers, AVSs, AI agents, and emerging infrastructure paradigms.

This post reflects on what we built, launched, and learned in 2025.

Setting the Direction

We entered 2025 with a clear conviction: the next phase of blockchain scalability would be driven by modularity, shared security, and application-specific rollups. Rather than one-size-fits-all L2s, the ecosystem was shifting toward bespoke execution environments tailored to gaming, DeFi, social, AI, and enterprise use cases.

To support this shift, AltLayer doubled down on:

  • Rollup-as-a-Service (RaaS)
  • Fast finality and shared security via restaking
  • Cross-ecosystem compatibility
  • Infrastructure that supports both Web3-native and emerging AI-driven applications

At the same time, we expanded our global team, strengthening engineering, protocol research, and ecosystem development as we scaled our ambitions.

Advancing Rollup-as-a-Service

At the heart of AltLayer’s work in 2025 was the continued evolution of our

Rollup-as-a-Service platform

Throughout the year, we:

  • Expanded support for multiple rollup stacks, including EVM-compatible and non-EVM environments
  • Enabled smoother deployment workflows for teams launching application-specific rollups
  • Improved configurability across execution, data availability, and settlement layers

AltLayer became one of the first external providers to support Starknet-based rollup deployments, while also extending support to emerging rollup frameworks and modular stacks. These improvements reduced time-to-launch for developers while preserving flexibility for advanced teams that needed deeper customization.

Fast Finality and Shared Security

One of the most important themes of 2025 was fast finality. As rollups proliferated, the need for stronger guarantees around transaction confirmation and economic security became increasingly clear. AltLayer worked closely with ecosystem partners to deliver fast-finality solutions backed by restaking and shared security models.

Key highlights included:

  • Launching a fast-finality layer for the Soneium ecosystem in collaboration with Astar Network and EigenLayer
  • Supporting Injective’s fast finality architecture for inEVM, improving UX and settlement assurances for DeFi applications

These integrations demonstrated how rollups could achieve near-instant finality without sacrificing decentralization, an important step forward for user-facing applications.

Expanding Across Ecosystems and Use Cases

2025 also marked a significant expansion of AltLayer’s ecosystem footprint. We supported rollups and infrastructure for projects across:

  • Gaming (including L2 deployments for gaming ecosystems)
  • Social platforms building scalable, user-centric chains
  • DeFi and zk-based systems
  • AI-focused rollups, exploring how blockchain infrastructure can support AI coordination and incentives
  • Bitcoin-adjacent ecosystems, extending rollup-related solutions beyond Ethereum

From Ethereum and BNB Chain to emerging environments and Bitcoin L2s, AltLayer continued to position itself as an infrastructure layer that adapts to different ecosystems rather than competing with them.

Wizard, Autonome, Rumour, and the Expansion into AI-Native Infrastructure

A major milestone in 2025 was AltLayer’s expansion beyond traditional rollup infrastructure to AVSs and into AI-native systems.

Wizard: As shared security and restaking matured throughout 2025, AVSs (Actively Validated Services) became a powerful new primitive, but also one that introduced significant complexity for teams looking to build on top of EigenLayer and similar systems.

To address this, we launched Wizard, AltLayer’s AVS-as-a-Service tool. Wizard was built to abstract away the operational and architectural overhead involved in launching an AVS. Instead of navigating validator orchestration, slashing conditions, service registration, and deployment workflows manually, teams can use Wizard to configure, deploy, and manage AVSs through a streamlined interface. This allowed builders to focus on the service logic itself rather than the underlying infrastructure.

By standardizing AVS deployment and lifecycle management, Wizard made shared security more accessible to a broader set of developers, whether they are building fast-finality layers, decentralized sequencers, data availability services, or application-specific security modules.

In many ways, Wizard extends AltLayer’s original RaaS philosophy into the restaking era. Just as Rollup-as-a-Service simplified the launch of custom execution environments, Wizard simplified the launch of custom security services, accelerating experimentation while maintaining strong economic guarantees. We worked with DIN (a Consensys project) to launch their AVS.

Autonome: With the launch of Autonome, we introduced a platform designed to support autonomous AI agents operating on-chain. Autonome explores how agents can coordinate, transact, and verify outcomes in decentralized environments, bringing together blockchain execution, cryptographic guarantees, and AI-driven decision-making. Rather than treating AI as an external tool, Autonome was built around the idea that agents themselves can become first-class participants in decentralized networks.

Rumour: Another most talked-about launch for AltLayer in 2025 was Rumour.app, a new kind of market platform designed to capture and act on early market signals before they become conventional news.

Traditionally, traders chase alpha by jumping between Telegram groups, Discord threads, and social feeds to spot whispers and tips that could move prices. Rumour.app streamlines that process by combining signal discovery, credibility validation, and trade execution in one seamless interface. Instead of reacting to confirmed headlines, traders can act on rumours themselves, compressing the gap between insight and execution, a window where some of the biggest opportunities live.

Launched during the 2025 conference season including Korea Blockchain Week and Token2049 Rumour.app brought this narrative-driven trading concept to life with real-world activity and community engagement. The platform was integrated with Hyperliquid and included initiatives like trading rewards and rumour submission competitions to encourage early participation.

At its core, Rumour.app acts as a rumor-to-execution pipeline: users can discover market whispers, assess their credibility through community signal validation, and then take a position without ever leaving the platform. This integration is what differentiates Rumour from fragmented workflows that trade too slowly for fast-moving markets.

By turning market chatter into tradable signal infrastructure, Rumour.app represents a bold step into narrative-driven trading, where speed, validation, and execution converge in a single experience, and where information becomes its own kind of alpha.

Together, Wizard, Autonome, and Rumour marked an important evolution for AltLayer. They represented a shift from purely scaling execution to supporting new forms of decentralized behavior, where rollups, fast-finality layers, and AI agents intersect. These launches laid the groundwork for future experimentation at the boundary of blockchain infrastructure and autonomous systems.

Cross-Chain and Network Milestones

Interoperability remained a priority throughout the year. In 2025, we:

  • Enabled ALT token transfers between Ethereum and Solana via Wormhole
  • Continued refining token economics and vesting structures to support long-term ecosystem sustainability

These efforts helped ensure that AltLayer’s network and token infrastructure scaled alongside adoption.

Security, Reliability, and Enterprise Readiness

As more teams relied on AltLayer for production infrastructure, security and compliance took center stage.

Towards the end of 2025, AltLayer progressed into the SOC 2 Type II audit phase, building on earlier compliance milestones. This marked an important step toward enterprise-grade reliability and operational maturity, particularly for partners exploring regulated or institutional use cases. Security reviews, infrastructure hardening, and operational transparency remained ongoing priorities throughout the year.

Community, Builders, and the Broader Ecosystem

Beyond protocol development, 2025 was also about people.

We engaged closely with:

  • Developers launching new rollups, agents, AVSs and more
  • Ecosystem partners experimenting with new designs
  • Communities building applications on top of AltLayer-powered infrastructure

Through events, workshops, collaborations, and ongoing technical support, we continued to learn alongside builders pushing the limits of what rollups can do.

Looking Ahead

By the end of 2025, AltLayer had evolved from a rollup infrastructure provider into a multi-ecosystem infrastructure as a service provider enabling fast, secure, and customizable blockchain and agent related services at scale.

The work we did this year across fast finality, restaking, AI-adjacent infrastructure, and cross-chain systems laid the groundwork for what comes next.

As we move into 2026, AltLayer’s focus is sharpening around a new frontier: agent-native infrastructure and coordination primitives.

The rise of autonomous agents that can reason, transact, and act independently demands new rails for identity, payments, discovery, and trust. Much of what we are building next sits at this intersection.

Agents as First-Class Participants

In 2026, we are doubling down on agent-centric systems. Rather than treating agents as off-chain tools that occasionally interact with blockchains, we are building infrastructure where agents are first-class network participants capable of discovering services, paying for access, coordinating with other agents, and operating at machine speed.

This shift informs much of our work across payments, registries, and observability.

x402 Payments: Machine-Native Commerce

A key piece of this vision is x402 – payment rails proposed by Coinbase designed specifically for agents and automated systems. x402 enables programmatic, pay-per-request interactions, allowing agents to seamlessly compensate other agents or services for data, execution, or coordination without human intervention. This opens the door to new economic models where APIs, services, and intelligence are monetized natively on-chain and consumed autonomously. AltLayer is building infrastructure around it such as Facilitator which helps orchestrate and route interactions between agents and services.

The 8004 Registry and Agent Discovery

To support this emerging ecosystem, we are continuing to build around the 8004 registry, a discovery and coordination layer for agents and services. The registry provides a shared source of truth for agent identities, capabilities, and endpoints, forming the foundation for trustless discovery and interaction. On top of this, we’ve begun rolling out supporting tooling such as 8004scan, which brings transparency and observability to the agent ecosystem. These tools represent early glimpses into a broader stack we are assembling, one focused on discovery, coordination, and composability in agent-driven networks.

What’s Next

While much of this work is already live or in active development, we see it as just the beginning. In 2026, we’ll continue expanding this stack, connecting agents, payments, registries, and execution environments into a more cohesive whole.

There is more coming across this surface area, and we’re excited to share it as it takes shape. Stay tuned for more updates and thank you to everyone who built with us, partnered with us, and challenged us in 2025.

The next chapter is just getting started!

A Very Happy New Year.

Reflections on 2025 and the Road Ahead for AltLayer was originally published in AltLayer on Medium, where people are continuing the conversation by highlighting and responding to this story.

item.title: AltLayer Enters SOC 2 Type II Audit Phase
item.dc:creator: AltLayer
item.content:encoded:
Certification to strengthen AltLayer’s credibility as top blockchain infrastructure solutions provider for rollups, AVS, verifiable agents, and innovative dApps.

Trust in Scalability-as-a-Service and Rollup Infrastructure

AltLayer, the infrastructure platform powering scalable rollups, Actively Validated Services (AVS), and verifiable agents, has officially entered the SOC 2 Type II audit phase.

This follows the successful completion of its SOC 2 Type I assessment, reinforcing AltLayer’s commitment to enterprise-grade security, operational reliability, and data protection.

AltLayer is redefining infrastructure hosting in Web3 by streamlining the launch and coordination of rollups, AVSs, and verifiable agents, across all major stacks, and with native support for restaking.

With billions in TVL secured via our RaaS and restaked products, AltLayer delivers best-in-class reliability, decentralization, and interoperability, acting as a backbone for high-value chains and innovative dApps.

The move to SOC 2 Type II signals AltLayer’s ongoing commitment to providing verifiable trust and performance to institutions, developers, and ecosystem partners.

SOC 2 for Operational Integrity

SOC 2 Type I (Service Organization Control 2) is an industry-recognized certification that evaluates a company’s controls and systems function properly at a given time. Its rigorous evaluation and auditing process examines A-Z operational and technical integrity, including: security, availability, reliability, processing, confidentiality, and privacy.

SOC 2 Type II tests go a step further, assessing if those controls perform well in real-world conditions over a long timeframe as opposed to being just a snapshot.

This next phase ensures that AltLayer continues to deliver institutional-grade infrastructure for the growing demands of rollup developers, AVS clients, restakers, and teams building on the modular stack.

AltLayer’s Current Compliance Milestones:

  • SOC 2 Type I ✅
  • SOC 2 Type II ⌛ (Expected Q1 2026)
  • ISO 27001:2022 ⌛️(Expected Q1 2026)

Built to Scale Securely

SOC 2 Type II offers users confidence that AltLayer’s systems are not only functional, but secure, consistent, and professionally operated. For restakers, operators, and institutional partners, it’s a signal that AltLayer’s infrastructure is built to withstand real-world demands, and is ready to scale!

As Web3 adoption spreads far and wide, AltLayer wants to guarantee trust and transparency. The SOC certification is certainly a step in that direction.

A full report will be made available to clients upon completion of the Type II audit. More updates are coming soon.

item.title: AltLayer Debuts Rumour, a Platform That Transforms Market Chatter Into Tradeable Alpha
item.dc:creator: AltLayer
item.content:encoded:
Try it at KBW and Token 2049; $40K up for grabs in Rumour campaigns this fall

Rumour.app, the world’s first rumour-trading platform built by AltLayer, is gearing up for its public debut this fall with campaigns during Korea Blockchain Week (KBW) and Token2049 Singapore.

Most traders today juggle multiple tools: scanning for signals, parsing chatrooms, assessing analytics, and only then executing trades — often missing the optimal entry window while switching between aggregators, messaging apps, and exchanges. Given that time is of the essence in a crypto market that never sleeps, speed is everything. Rumour.app solves this fragmentation with its whispers-to-execution pipeline: traders can validate, act, and execute trades directly inside the platform.

Built on the belief that gossip, speculation, and early signals drive markets as much as fundamentals, Rumour fuses humanity’s age-old love of intelligence sharing with Web3’s fast-paced trading culture. On Rumour, traders, builders, and crypto communities globally can share, engage, and unite around narratives that shape markets, all while enjoying a seamless trading experience powered by Hyperliquid.

YQ Jia, CEO, AltLayer said: “Rumour was designed for a generation that doesn’t wait. They innovate. They seize opportunities, own the cycles, and set the tone. This isn’t noise trading. Rumour is designed to filter the chatter, spot early rumours in the haystack, and turn them into coordinated market action.”

Let’s take a look at Rumours’ cutting-edge features:

  • Mobile native: Built for traders on the move, because split-second reactions can make or break a trade
  • Signal-first chatrooms: Real-time alpha-sharing hubs where leads, hot tips, secrets and narratives are shared, debated, and traded without sacrificing privacy
  • Hands-free leverage: Powered by Hyperliquid APIs: deposit once, automate positions, mirror directional bias with leverage

Speaking on why Rumour matters today, Jia said: “Metas make markets. We’ve seen this across every cycle — DeFi Summer, NFTs and metaverse, play-to-earn, modularity season, memecoins mania, AI, SocialFi, RWAs, stablecoins.. you name it. Some are quick to seize the moment, while others get lost in the noise. Rumour will channel chatter into action without the fragmentation of bouncing between a dozen chat rooms, exchanges and dashboards.”

Rumour has it: $40,000 Up for Grabs!

Rumours’ pre-launch campaign runs from 20 September through October, with a cumulative pot of $40,000 in rewards for early adopters. Here’s a breakdown:

Spill tea at Korea Blockchain Week [21–26 September]

AltLayer will be distributing referral access links for Rumour at Korea Blockchain Week and key side events. Whether you’re a trader, crypto enthusiast, builder, SocialFi explorer, or simply a fan of innovative platforms, you’re invited to test Rumour and earn exclusive rewards.

  • Trading Rewards: A prize pool of $15,000 in ALT awaits eager traders. The first 500 new users to trade above $10,000 in volume receive $30 in ALT, deposited directly into their in-app wallet
  • Rumour Submission Contest: An additional $5,000 awaits those who share the best rumours and news

Korea Blockchain Week (main event) Bithumb Zone’s Airdrop

Special sweetener: On 23–24 September, KBW attendees with a Bithumb account can participate in a parallel Rumour campaign by simply signing up, submitting a new rumour, and opening up a discussion. On each day, the first 150 people to complete the task will receive 320 ALT directly into their Bithumb wallet.

Token 2049 Beckons all Rumour Traders! [28 September — 3 October]

  • Trading Rewards: A prize pool of $15,000 in ALT awaits eager traders. The first 500 new users to trade above $10,000 in volume receive $30 in ALT, deposited directly into their in-app wallet
  • Rumour Submission Contest: An additional $5,000 awaits those who share the best rumours and news

Together, these activations kick off Rumours’ global rollout, designed to capture crypto’s hottest news, tips, secrets, and scandals at the height of the fall conference season.

item.title: AltLayer now supports Polkadot Native Rollups
item.dc:creator: AltLayer
item.content:encoded:
We’re proud to announce that AltLayer now extends full support to Polkadot Native Rollups, in collaboration with the Polkadot Deployment Portal (PDP).

Courtesy of our RaaS hosting services, developers can now deploy, scale, and manage Polkadot-based rollups effortlessly — no heavy lifting required.

Whether you’re a builder of DeFi, GameFi, SocialFi, InfoFi or beyond, AltLayer makes it seamless to:
✅ Launch high-performance Polkadot Native Rollups
✅ Customize your chain in minutes, not months
✅ Enjoy low fees, minimal downtime, and modular flexibility

Simplifying the path from idea to launch, AltLayer elevates the experience for Polkadot rollups. We focus on backend fundamentals, so that builders can focus on their product.

We’re aligned with Polkadot’s vision

Polkadot was an early and vocal advocate for a multichain Web3. Their focus on modularity and shared security further backs their vision with strong technology (decentralized appchains & agile development via rollups) — and we’re here for it. As a powerful ecosystem calling for scalable, secure and interoperable on-chain experience, we found great alignment with their approach and so naturally, we were excited to work with them.

By supporting Polkadot Native Rollups, we’re unlocking powerful new possibilities for builders who want the performance of app-specific chains with the ease of plug-and-play deployment.

Projects will have access to a comprehensive toolkit designed to help them go from zero to launch in days — one that includes infra primitives, security add-ons, funding advisory and more).

Once the groundwork has been laid, AltLayer can further accelerate the rollups. With our Rollups-as-a-Service (RaaS) dashboard and full-stack configurability at their fingertips, devs can launch a Polkadot Native Rollup in minutes, not months. AltLayer’s value to the Polkadot ecosystem is clear: build fast, scale smart, and skip the infrastructure headaches.

item.title: AltLayer supports Gattaca’s based rollup stack
item.dc:creator: AltLayer
item.content:encoded:
TL;DR → Gattaca has developed a based rollup stack that transforms an OP stack rollup into a based rollup with pre-confirmations. Get strong transaction guarantees in milliseconds while enjoying full Ethereum security! AltLayer now supports Gattaca’s based rollups.

Gattaca, built by the team behind major Ethereum block builder Titan builder, is transforming OP stack rollups into “based rollups” to enhance reliability, performance, and liveness guarantees with its “overlay” layer. We are excited to announce that AltLayer’s RaaS users deploying on Optimism’s OP stack can benefit from these higher-performing based sequencing capabilities.

Let us take a step back to explore based rollups and how they benefit rollup users.

Understanding Based Rollups

Based rollups use Ethereum validators to determine transaction ordering, rather than relying on external sequencers. This approach leverages Ethereum’s decentralized validator network to provide stronger liveness guarantees compared to single-node sequencer setups that suffer from centralization risks. These based rollups will unlock shared sequencing across multiple rollups, and in turn, synchronous composability across the ecosystem.

Ethereum validators include rollup transactions every 12 seconds when new blocks are created. Your rollup’s transaction sequencing is delegated by Ethereum’s proposers to a decentralized set of sequencers, i.e. they’re “based” on Ethereum.

The Gattaca overlay powers AltLayer’s OP Stack rollups

Moreover, the Gattaca overlay introduces an intermediate confirmation layer that allows much faster confirmation of transactions. Rollup blocks are sliced into 200ms fragments (Frags), which the rotating sequencer “confirms” and gossips, thereby providing transaction preconfirmations every 200ms rather than the full block time. Think of it as assurance, like getting a bank’s transaction confirmation receipt even though the funds may take a few days to settle in the bank’s back office.

Gattaca has already released the Phase 1 roadmap, which shows huge promise to create a highly performant based rollup leveraging OP Stack.

This design ensures fast transactions, smoother UX, and economic security while plugging in gaps like liveness failures or regulatory issues caused by centralized sequencers. More specifically, users can be assured of:

  • Decentralized sequencing that can’t be tampered with
  • MEV protection through Ethereum’s proposer-builder separation, which handles extraction more fairly and transparently
  • Cross-rollup interoperability
  • Reliable speed for latency-sensitive dApps
  • Guaranteed liveness linked to Ethereum

Moreover, an AltLayer-provisioned Gattaca rollup will feature built-in redundancy and security measures to ensure robustness and reliability including RPC redundancy, rate limiting and load protection, and 24 x 7 monitoring & system health checks.

Transform your OP Stack rollup with Gattaca Overlay, and empower your users with speed, scale and reliability. Get in touch with support@altresear.ch

item.title: AltLayer and Astar Network’s Community Proposal for Soneium MACH: Now Live!
item.dc:creator: AltLayer
item.content:encoded:
Hi all,

Delighted to share that AltLayer and Astar Network’s proposal to integrate a fast-finality layer for Soneium rollups is now ➡️ LIVE ⬅️

The proposal outlines our collective approach to bringing fast-finality on Soneium with MACH AVS (Actively Validated Service powered by EigenLayer), which is secured by the restaking of ASTR, restaked ETH and other LSTs.

Why does Soneium need fast-finality?

Users deploying on Soneium’s OP Stack rollup typically experience either soft finality offered by its sequencer or hard finality when rollup transactions settle on Ethereum. Even today, it takes ≈ 13 min for an Ethereum block to finalize. and let’s not forget — the settlement period is often lengthy, followed by a long withdrawal period of around 7 days.

Given Soneium’s goal to serve high-latency applications and fuel the creator economy, quick finality would revolutionize Soneium’s architecture, trickling all the way down to devs and creators.

AltLayer taps into its AVS expertise

Our MACH AVS, powered by EigenLayer’s restaking mechanism, provides fast confirmation for rollup transactions, crypto-economic security guarantees, support for both ZK/optimistic rollups and compatibility with different proof systems and runtimes. This opens up myriad benefits for Soneium, like:

  1. A boost in transaction speed
  2. A strong and trusted network and community around the token via staking incentives
  3. Convenient access to AltLayer’s trusted network of AVS operators, ETH validators, and restakers to secure the network over time

Working closely with Astar Network to unlock unlimited potential in Soneium rollups

To secure Soneium’s MACH AVS, we will leverage EigenLayer’s restaking mechanism. Along with the restaked ETH, we propose leveraging the bridged ASTR token (the LSTs representing staked ASTR tokens) for Soneium.

Using ASTR token for economic security will not only create a token sink but also help bring together different stakeholders such as token holders, operators, VCs and broader community to help operate the MACH network that can benefit user and dApps alike. Astar’s role within the Soneium ecosystem has also been discussed on their forum page.

The detailed case for using MACH AVS can be found on this page, and is under review. We welcome your feedback and suggestions as we seek to elevate scalability, decentralization, and security for Soneium, and in the process, gather data on our fast-finality layer in action.

item.title: AltLayer Receives 1M EIGEN Token Grant from Eigen Foundation
item.dc:creator: AltLayer
item.content:encoded:
And It Will All Go to the AltLayer Community!

We’re thrilled to announce that AltLayer has been awarded a retroactive grant of 1 million EIGEN tokens from the Eigen Foundation. This generous reward recognizes our past and ongoing contributions to the EigenLayer ecosystem.

What This Grant Means

AltLayer has been deeply involved with the EigenLayer ecosystem since its inception, even before the core EigenLayer contracts were publicly released. Over time, our role within the ecosystem has grown significantly, evolving as an AVS builder, AVS operator, technology contributor, marketing partner, distribution partner for EigenDA, and more.

More concretely, AltLayer has contributed to the EigenLayer ecosystem in the following ways:

  • As an AVS builder: AltLayer introduced the notion of restaked rollups using three vertically integrated AVSs called MACH, VITAL and SQUAD that benefit rollups with better decentralization, security, liveness and interoperability. As a part of its MACH offering, AltLayer has directly launched 5 AVSs so far. These AVSs have recorded an aggregate of $25B in restaked assets, and counting..!
  • As an ecosystem growth partner: AltLayer has helped foster ecosystem growth through cross-community incentivization. To kick off the culture of playing infinite games, AltLayer has in the past airdropped over 50M ALT tokens to both restakers and builders in the EigenLayer ecosystem.
  • As an AVS operator: AltLayer-run operator is the second largest operator in terms of number of delegators, serving 18 AVSs.
  • As a tech contributor for AVS tooling: AltLayer has contributed to various AVS toolings. The most prominent one is a no-code AVS deployment tool called Wizard. Wizard was most recently used to build and launch the GoPlus AVS.
  • As a distribution partner for EigenDA: On the non-AVS side, AltLayer through its RaaS service has brought several rollup projects such as Xterio, Cyber, BirdLayer, LogX, among many others to use EigenDA.
  • As a marketing partner: AltLayer has co-hosted our flagship Rollup Day event and other hackathons with EigenLayer. Drawing a massive and diverse crowd of devs, industry visionaries, C-suite, and ecosystem participants, these global events (held in hotspots like Brussels, Paris, Hong Kong, Istanbul, Singapore, Bangkok) have been a great forum for shedding light on concepts like restaking, AVSs, popular and upcoming rollup infra and its use cases, the Layer 2 ecosystem, and more! These initiatives have not only accelerated the adoption of EigenLayer but also set a new standard for community contribution.

The retroactive grant underscores Eigen Foundation’s commitment to rewarding projects that contribute to the EigenLayer ecosystem, and is a testament to our alignment with EigenLayer and its vision. It also highlights a forward-thinking approach to incentivizing ecosystem contributors and encourages contributors like AltLayer to take bold steps and invest in long-term ecosystem-building, knowing their efforts will be valued.

AltLayer’s Plans with the Token Grant

AltLayer’s contributions to EigenLayer and its ecosystem have always been fueled by the incredible support of our community. Every milestone we’ve achieved, every innovation we’ve delivered, has been possible because of your unwavering trust and belief in our mission.

With this in mind, it was only natural that the entirety of the 1M EIGEN token grant be directed to our community — the very backbone of our ecosystem.

The decision to allocate the 1M EIGEN grant to our community reflects our unwavering gratitude and commitment to those who have supported us from the beginning.

While the Eigen Foundation left the allocation of this grant to our discretion, we saw this as a unique opportunity to give back directly to the backbone of our ecosystem, our community. This approach aligns with our shared core values and reinforces our common belief in fostering long-term growth and collaboration.

Out of the 1 million EIGEN tokens, the first tranche of 500,000 will be distributed to holders of reALT tokens. To qualify, users must either have held reALT tokens in their wallet or deposited reALT on EigenLayer. More details on the snapshot below.

The remaining 500,000 EIGEN tokens will be distributed sometime next year when EigenLayer’s reward mechanism (v2) goes live on the mainnet.

Snapshot & Claim Details

The snapshot for reALT tokens was taken on a weekly basis over the following time period: May 9, 2024 (midnight) GMT to December 12, 2024 (midnight) GMT. You must have held reALT tokens in this period to qualify for the airdrop.

The claim website is available at

➡️ https://stake.altlayer.io/rewards/eigen ⬅️

This is the only place to claim EIGEN tokens. Beware of any phishing links!

Airdrop can be claimed from Friday, 20 December 2024 03:00:00 GMT till Thursday, 20 February 2025 03:00:00 GMT.

Thank you once again for your steadfast support, your belief in our vision, and your commitment to AltLayer. This milestone belongs to all of us.

Looking Ahead

With this grant, AltLayer is even more determined to push the boundaries of what’s possible with restaking. More concretely, we plan to:

  • Migrate ALT staking, currently operating outside of EigenLayer restaking contracts to AltLayer AVS.
  • Expand our infrastructure to enable more developers to leverage EigenLayer’s potential.
  • Introduce advanced tools for better user and developer experience with restaking.
  • Foster collaborations with other ecosystem projects to build a stronger and more nurturing restaking landscape.

A Heartfelt Thank You to the Eigen Foundation

We extend our deepest gratitude to the Eigen Foundation for their support and trust. This milestone is not just a win for AltLayer but a celebration of the entire EigenLayer ecosystem and its growing community of innovators.

Stay tuned for more updates as we continue to build, innovate, and contribute to the restaking vision.
